reasoning_traces.think:
The activation funnel defines a sequence of user actions leading to paid conversion. The rate C = N_paid/N_total quantifies this progression. In GSI, this rate is treated as a stochastic variable subject to Bayesian inference, where P(C|E) reflects updated beliefs about conversion efficiency after observing evidence E. The GSE system uses this posterior to perform state transitions S_{t+1} = f(S_t, C, E), enabling autonomous adaptation. Dualities emerge between the deterministic nature of the funnel and the probabilistic interpretation of C. Failure modes include data contamination, incorrect assumptions about independence of E, and misalignment of f with actual user behavior dynamics.
